bodies: FDP Institute, an affiliate of the CAIA Association
Certified Equity Professional Institute, Santa Clara University
Alliance of Merger and Acquisition Advisors (AM&AA)

exams.name: Associate Professional Risk Manager Certificate
exams.blurb: Foundation certificate on risk management concepts, governance and financial instruments for non-specialists supporting risk teams.

exams.name: CAIA Level I Exam
exams.blurb: First alternative investments paper covering professional standards, real assets, hedge funds, private equity and structured products.

exams.name: CAIA Level II Exam
exams.blurb: Second alternative investments paper covering asset allocation, risk management, manager selection and essay-based current topics.

exams.name: Certificate in ESG Investing
exams.blurb: Single-exam certificate covering environmental, social and governance factors, engagement and ESG integration in portfolio construction.

exams.name: Certificate in Investment Performance Measurement
exams.blurb: Two-level programme on return calculation, performance attribution, risk-adjusted measures, manager selection and GIPS standards.

exams.name: Certificate in Quantitative Finance
exams.blurb: Part-time programme with assignments and a final project covering derivatives pricing, quantitative risk and machine learning in finance.

exams.name: CFA Program Level I Exam
exams.blurb: First CFA paper testing investment tools, ethics, quantitative methods, economics, financial reporting and asset class basics.

exams.name: CFA Program Level II Exam
exams.blurb: Second CFA paper of item-set vignettes focused on asset valuation across equity, fixed income, derivatives and alternatives.

exams.name: CFA Program Level III Exam
exams.blurb: Final CFA paper combining constructed response and item sets on portfolio management, wealth planning and specialised pathways.

exams.name: Climate Risk, Valuation and Investing Certificate
exams.blurb: Self-paced certificate with a final assessment on climate science, transition risk, scenario analysis and valuation implications.

exams.name: CMT Level I Exam
exams.blurb: First technical analysis paper covering chart construction, trend analysis, indicators, market breadth and ethical standards.

exams.name: CMT Level II Exam
exams.blurb: Second technical analysis paper applying theory to pattern recognition, intermarket analysis, cycles and quantitative techniques.

exams.name: CMT Level III Exam
exams.blurb: Final technical analysis paper using constructed response questions on integrating analysis into portfolio and risk decisions.

exams.name: Financial Data Professional Exam
exams.body: FDP Institute, an affiliate of the CAIA Association
exams.blurb: Single examination on data science for investment management, covering machine learning, big data and model interpretation.

exams.name: Financial Risk Manager Exam Part I
exams.blurb: First risk management paper covering foundations of risk, quantitative analysis, financial markets and valuation and risk models.

exams.name: Financial Risk Manager Exam Part II
exams.blurb: Second risk management paper covering market, credit, operational, liquidity and investment risk plus current financial issues.

exams.name: Operational Risk Manager Certificate
exams.blurb: Certificate examination covering operational risk frameworks, loss data, scenario analysis, controls and regulatory expectations.

exams.name: Private Markets and Alternative Investments Certificate
exams.blurb: Certificate programme covering private equity, private debt, real assets and infrastructure, with structure, valuation and due diligence.

exams.name: Professional Risk Manager Designation Exams
exams.blurb: Multi-exam designation covering risk theory, mathematical foundations, risk management practice and professional conduct standards.

exams.name: Sustainability and Climate Risk Certificate
exams.blurb: Single-exam certificate covering climate science, the energy transition, disclosure frameworks and climate risk measurement.

exams.name: ACCA Applied Knowledge Exams
exams.blurb: First ACCA level with three papers on business and technology, management accounting and financial accounting fundamentals.

exams.name: ACCA Applied Skills Exams
exams.blurb: Second ACCA level with six papers spanning corporate law, performance management, taxation, reporting, audit and financial management.

exams.name: ACCA Strategic Professional Exams
exams.blurb: Final ACCA level combining two essential papers with two options covering advanced audit, taxation, reporting and financial management.

exams.name: Capital Markets and Securities Analyst Certification
exams.blurb: Online certification covering fixed income, derivatives, trading strategies, portfolio construction and capital markets mechanics.

exams.name: Certified Corporate FP&A Professional
exams.blurb: Two-part certification covering financial planning and analysis tools, forecasting, modelling, business partnering and decision support.

exams.name: Certified Equity Professional Level 1
exams.body: Certified Equity Professional Institute, Santa Clara University
exams.blurb: First level of the equity compensation credential covering plan types, accounting, taxation and securities law fundamentals.

exams.name: Certified Equity Professional Level 2
exams.body: Certified Equity Professional Institute, Santa Clara University
exams.blurb: Second level of the equity compensation credential, deepening accounting, tax and regulatory treatment of share-based awards.

exams.name: Certified Equity Professional Level 3
exams.body: Certified Equity Professional Institute, Santa Clara University
exams.blurb: Final level of the equity compensation credential covering complex global plans, corporate transactions and advanced compliance.

exams.name: Certified Fund Specialist
exams.blurb: Designation programme on mutual funds, exchange traded funds and closed-end funds, including selection, taxation and portfolio use.

exams.name: Certified Merger and Acquisition Advisor
exams.body: Alliance of Merger and Acquisition Advisors (AM&AA)
exams.blurb: Middle-market deal credential covering valuation, deal structuring, due diligence, tax and transaction process management.

exams.name: CIMA Certificate in Business Accounting
exams.blurb: Entry qualification with four objective tests in management accounting, financial accounting, business economics and business law.

exams.name: Financial Modeling and Valuation Analyst Certification
exams.blurb: Online certification covering three-statement modelling, DCF valuation, budgeting, Excel technique and presentation of financial analysis.

exams.name: GFOA Certified Public Finance Officer Debt Management Exam
exams.blurb: Component examination of the public finance officer programme covering municipal debt issuance, structuring, disclosure and administration.

exams.name: Investor Relations Charter
exams.blurb: Certification examination covering securities disclosure, capital markets, corporate governance and investor communication strategy.

exams.name: Merger and Acquisition Master Intermediary
exams.blurb: Designation for lower middle-market intermediaries requiring completed transactions, advanced coursework and a written examination.

exams.name: WorldCC Contract and Commercial Management Advanced Practitioner
exams.blurb: Highest tier of the commercial contracting certification, assessed by case study on negotiation strategy and complex deal governance.

exams.name: WorldCC Contract and Commercial Management Associate
exams.blurb: Entry certification covering the contracting lifecycle, commercial terms, risk allocation and supplier relationship fundamentals.

exams.name: WorldCC Contract and Commercial Management Practitioner
exams.blurb: Second tier certification covering contract drafting, negotiation planning, performance management and commercial risk analysis.
